subject: Re: Helio telemetry — artifact routing, log-sample window & sync summary
messages:
From: Alex Moore <alex.moore@heliotherapeutics.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: security@heliotherapeutics.com
Date: 2026-09-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Helio telemetry access & sample logs — scheduling

Diego,

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier. Our security team is preparing the SIG validation and we have two requests before the intake call:

1) A one-hour window where Redwood can demo the log export flow and show a representative sample (we need to verify redaction and retention metadata).
2) A short artifact routing plan that describes where sample logs will be uploaded, expected formats, and retention for Helio's review.

Can we line up a 30–45 minute technical sync this week for the export demo and to confirm the artifacts? Preferably the afternoon Pacific.

Also: please bring the suggested list of files (we primarily need app logs, inference request traces, and platform audit events) and a sample redaction checklist.

Cheers,
Alex Moore
Staff, InfoSec — Helio Therapeutics
attachments: none
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: Alex Moore <alex.moore@heliotherapeutics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-20T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Helio telemetry access & sample logs — scheduling

Alex — thanks for laying this out. We can absolutely do a focused demo and walk through the routing. Proposed slots (Pacific):
- Tue 2026-09-21 14:00–14:45 PT
- Wed 2026-09-22 15:00–15:45 PT

Neha will own the demo of the log-export flow and the redaction checklist. Marissa will present the artifact routing doc and the upload destination options (Drive vs SFTP).

Quick notes so we prep the right materials:
- File types: we plan to provide gzipped JSON lines for app logs, compressed protobuf for inference traces, and CSV/JSON for audit events.
- Redaction: we will demonstrate application-level redaction + token-level masking that we run before export.
- Retention: samples will live for 7 days on our internal staging bucket; full retention policy details will be included in the workbook.

I attached a short instructions PDF on how we generate a one-off sample and a current SIG workbook export (v4) for Helio to scan ahead of the call.

Which slot works for you? If neither, we can extend to Thursday morning.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_log_sample_instructions.pdf; sig_workbook_v4.xlsx
From: Alex Moore <alex.moore@heliotherapeutics.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: security@heliotherapeutics.com
Date: 2026-09-20T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Helio telemetry access & sample logs — scheduling

Diego — Wed 2026-09-22 15:00 PT works for our team (Alex + two engineers).

Two follow-ups before the demo:
- Can the sample include a trace showing redactable PII fields and the post-redaction output? Ideally a before/after pair.
- For the staging bucket retention: can Helio request data deletion after the 7-day sample window? We need confirmation of deletion and logs of who accessed the sample.

We'll prepare a short checklist of acceptance criteria for the sample so we can sign off on the demo.

Thanks,
Alex
attachments: sample_acceptance_checklist.docx (will share before the call)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Alex Moore <alex.moore@heliotherapeutics.com>
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-21T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Helio telemetry access & sample logs — scheduling

Alex — great, confirmed Wed 2026-09-22 15:00–15:45 PT (Calendar invite sent). A few pre-call items so we can keep the meeting focused:

Prep we are sending before the call (links/attachments):
- SIG workbook (v4) — contains the mapping of SIG questions to artifacts and owners (attached).
- redwood_log_sample_instructions.pdf — step-by-step for how we create and tag the sample export.
- A short script snippet (in the workbook) that shows the redaction rules applied.

Answers to two of your asks:
- Before/after: yes, we'll include a redaction demo: one synthetic trace (cleansed) plus the original with synthetic PII inserted for verification.
- Deletion: we can schedule an automated lifecycle job to delete the sample at T+7 days and will provide an access log report for the sample’s object key. The deletion job runs as a named automation account and we will include the automation account id in the artifact manifest.

Agenda for the 45-minute sync (strict):
1) 5m intro & objectives
2) 15m demo of export + redaction before/after
3) 15m artifact routing options & where files land (Drive link + SFTP option)
4) 5m confirmation of acceptance criteria & next steps
5) 5m Q&A / wrap

If Helio requires additional logging metadata (e.g., per-object ACL history), please flag it now and we'll include it in the artifact manifest.

See the attached SIG workbook and instructions (same files Diego referenced).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Security Programs Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: sig_workbook_v4.xlsx; redwood_log_sample_instructions.pdf
From: Alex Moore <alex.moore@heliotherapeutics.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: security@heliotherapeutics.com
Date: 2026-09-23T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Helio telemetry access & sample logs — scheduling

Thanks Marissa — the agenda looks good and the artifacts are helpful. A couple of quick confirmations ahead of tomorrow's call:

- We'll review the redaction before/after and the access log report. If the automated deletion job can provide a signed deletion record (object id + timestamp + automation account id), that would satisfy our compliance auditors.
- For routing, Helio prefers Drive for quick review but will request an SFTP handoff if we need to ingest into our internal tooling — we'll confirm during the session.

See you all tomorrow. I'll bring the two Helio engineers and our compliance manager; they'll primarily listen and validate against the acceptance checklist I'll share in the calendar thread.

Alex Moore
Staff, InfoSec — Helio Therapeutics
